caption: The drawing depicts two deer, one standing and one lying down, within a forested setting. The standing deer, positioned on the left, has large antlers and brown coloring, with darker outlines emphasizing features such as the legs, neck, and facial details. The deer that is lying down is on the right, and it is also colored in brown with similar darker outlines as the standing deer. Both deer have pale accents on their bodies. The background contains several green trees with thin trunks and sparse, spreading branches, indicated by fine green lines. The ground is lightly shaded with green, gray, and faint purple tones, suggesting grass and earth. The central scene is surrounded by a thin red border, which is edged with an evenly stitched yellow and white border. Outside this is a wide, dark reddish-purple border, with the corners sewn together. The entire composition is done in a manner that suggests the image is embroidered onto a fabric square.
title: Applique Coverlet (Detail)
